notes.title: Are you ready to enjoy Full Release of Throw Anything?
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/81fd27d1c22166e7cc3932091a0156e89ed6f5a5.png

Thanks to your interest, Throw Anything has finally come as Full Release!

And here's very special patch note that you awaited for!

Stage 6!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/ae94dad42f1604579aa51d5231b849a8150290bf.jpg

ㆍFinally, Mystery scientist shows himself in new stage! Can you defeat him and save the world? Try to collect all Relics in all stages and face the true ending!

New Items and New enemy!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/ff20a94e7a9db29278cd6c56639dbb1026dcc545.gif
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/b51ab7e3498786d34778e9c5dd50b7c8e5ff37ef.gif
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/ab1364f0be53daca9ab5e1eb35debf08cb372f91.gif
ㆍFace off Scientist X's last zombie horde! And here are the most effective weapons to defeat the zombies! All you have to do... is Throw Anything! And shooting of course..

Lobby

The secret government foundation SDA helped you to find the cubes more effectively by providing airships!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/6acdb21e1b17f4ae2b76baac2ff0fc2a9a4a47b3.gif
Test all weapons in shooting range and try to get high score in simulation training!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/3b684c7ffdf76476cbcd1cdc91f9652d7ac4a96b.gif
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/1d640d062a28ecbc8bda47c387e956055078f5a8.gif
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/80108367fd4a97f9b294b69f1872237fcef09440.gif
Rest is also a very important part to fight against zombies.
Enjoy wasting time to playing basketball or eating!
Also, reading books or throwing darts can be pleasure!

Thank you to everyone who has been waiting for our game. Your interest and love has brought our game here. We will see you again with more updates and more fun!

notes.title: Throw Anything patch note Version 1.0!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/eb75fdb0c01c9caef1496fbd3eedcab194b31540.png
Throw Anything patch note Version 1.0!
Throw anything's update is done! In this update, you'll be able to experience vending machine, new interactions, and new effects with improvement!

Vending machine:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/03b3891975d33f2cdc05fe746d2cef1a87270b45.gif
ㆍNow the vending machine is added on lobby! The vending machine can use the points from the game to get weapons that can be used in the next stage! But be aware, all points are lost after the game starts! If you have accumulated enough points, be sure to check the lobby!

Easy & Hard:

ㆍSeveral streamers and users say that the game is difficult so we decide adjust the difficulty of game. Plus, easy mod and hard mod is now available! Now try your own limit!

Balance:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/05666b1979faa42a6ceb043ac50e0470c862a435.gif
ㆍNow the game player & it's cartridge is added in Stage 1! Combine game player and cartridge to get powerful items!
ㆍNew NPC zombie is added on Stage 5.
ㆍNow the bombs, grenades, and rocket launcher brings more massive explosions.
ㆍWhen safe is open before password comes, it never comes from delivery.

UI & Effect:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/923dab1c326bd49915a5915777ac96e9ff59a93f.gif
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/02ff30f877b6d820e7a311dc98ba78c8d2c525c7.gif
ㆍNow sound option is added on lobby.
ㆍDifficulty level button is also added on lobby.
ㆍWhen one of Jack or Shane lost all health, creepy aura come out to the other.

Bug fixed:

ㆍFixed bug when delivery copied by copy machine brings no item.
ㆍFixed bug achievement 'grand rescue' applied to all login player.

Please check our twitter and Facebook for more information of our game!

notes.title: Throw Anything patch note Version 0.1!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/89fd81456a9678e5edf45d2da3f608467990df6d.png
Throw Anything patch note Version 0.1!
Howdy! This is Throw anything!
We always appreciate your interest in our game!
For your better playing, we decided to release our first patch note.

ㆍA less stupid NPC
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/f1d663700aa56c69066dc00f360e7f1815a37302.gif
NPC would no longer return to its default position when it touch window frame, but modify window frame to push or pull NPC to its direction. And also, NPC won’t stuck to you anymore!

ㆍRefrigerator wants more food! (Stage 3)
The refrigerator has been modified to catch food! Now refrigerator will no longer reflect any object before freeze it.

ㆍZombie always need ‘Molotov’! (Stage 3)
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/6741f5141c749fc3b1431a9be5f73c5521cada36.gif
The new item ‘Molotov’ is now added on room & delivery services! Throw ‘Molotov’ to wall will create flame wall which deals damage to passing zombies.

ㆍFreeze everything, ‘Blizzard gauntlet’ (Stage 3)
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/00195732d562298c1ec82e6cc5ec42b8e5059bc3.gif
The new item ‘Blizzard gauntlet’ is now added on mailbox! Wear ‘Blizzard gauntlet’ and touch any object to freeze (Include zombies)! Throwing frozen object will make zombies tremble in cold. Also, speed of pulling object will increase.

ㆍA troublesome fly (Bird zombie)
Bird zombies are no longer harmful than before, it will spend more time to kill you!

ㆍNew achievements
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/c6c08c5b1f95b0830faa5a4a80a334153b754b99.png
New achievements have been added. User who have already accomplished this new achievement will apply at the beginning of the game.

ㆍTutorial mod has been updated!
Now tutorials are more granular for beginners to follow!
And also tutorial teaches you how to interact between torch and fuel!
So for passing Stage 3, you must play it again!

And here’s our next update plan!
ㆍMore items!
ㆍDifficulty selection!
ㆍMore stories!
ㆍBuff some items!

Please check our twitter, and facebook for more information of our game!

notes.title: Throw Anything release & Feedback!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/af378042a4ff75da97260525d8197ea2f70c42fb.png
ㆍThrow Anything release!
Early access to Throw Anything is coming to the Steam Store on February 28, 2018!
Are you ready to knock down the zombies climbing up to your room?
Throw Anything you can get your hands on to defend yourself against the zombies.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/dd83da8f77877095378ece532f26b7e3a2e20a63.png
ㆍFeedback!
As an Early Access game, feedback is always welcome for Throw Anything.
New items and stages can be added based on your feedback!
If your idea is added to the game, your name will go down in history in the end-credits! :D
We will work together with your ideas until the official release. 
Please send us lots of feedback through SNS!   

Twitter -  https://twitter.com/Kaleb_Jung

Google+ - https://plus.google.com/u/0/110559454882041898306

Get more information about Throw Anything on our Website.

Enjoy a dynamic and thrilling VR experience with Throw Anything.
